remarks: Welcome to Sheffield Ridge, where easy living meets breathtaking Long Island Sound views! Perched on the top floor, this bright and inviting 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condominium offers 684 square feet of comfortable living space, abundant closet space throughout, and especially generous storage in the bedroom. A recently renovated bathroom adds a fresh, modern touch and is one of the standout features of this well-maintained home. Enjoy the added convenience of an elevator building and a lifestyle designed for simplicity, with parking and an HOA that includes heat, cooking gas, water, and hot water, helping make monthly expenses more predictable. Additional amenities include laundry and storage in the building's lower level. Ideally located near parks, SoNo Mall, South Norwalk's vibrant restaurants and shops, Norwalk Hospital, the Norwalk Train Station, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway, this home puts everything you need within easy reach. Whether you're looking for a first home, a pied-a-terre, or a smart investment opportunity, this top-floor Sheffield Ridge condo delivers comfort, convenience, and a setting you'll be proud to call home.
